provenance.source: 3DLF scan dataset, calib_pro/intrinsics/rgb_optic.json (identical bytes in the dragon, armadillo and bunny sets)
provenance.source_model: brown5 with p1 = p2 = 0, which is exactly radialk3
provenance.note: Factory calibration stated for 583x385. The 3DLF photos are 1749x1155, exactly 3x; scaling the model to them is an assumption that has not been independently verified. sensor_width_mm is nominal and only fixes the unit of the focal length written into the AliceVision scene.
